findings.title: Two different time limits for a satisfactory drill
findings.explanation: Section 6 says a drill is satisfactory only if the evacuation time is six minutes or less. Section 7 says the report records it as satisfactory at eight minutes or less. A drill that takes seven minutes is unsatisfactory under section 6, which requires a repeat drill, but the report must call it satisfactory under section 7. The reader cannot obey both.
quotes: A drill is satisfactory if the evacuation time is six minutes or less and the sum equalled the attendance record.
The report records the drill as satisfactory when the evacuation time is eight minutes or less and the sum equalled the attendance record.

findings.title: No role is assigned to reset the alarm system
findings.explanation: The step requires the alarm system to be reset before anyone returns, but it is written in the passive voice. No passage in the document gives this action to a role. The Safety Manager announces the end of the drill and the Fire Wardens tell occupants to return, yet nobody is told to do the reset or to confirm it.
quotes: The alarm system is reset before any occupant returns to the building.

findings.explanation: The step requires the alarm system to be reset before anyone returns. It is written in the passive voice and names no role.
